$comment: GAIA verify lanes — local mirror of CI quality gates (.github/workflows/code-quality.yml + main.yml). name matches the CI job/step (rows may be step-granular). ci_job = the code-quality.yml job that runs the lane; `verdict.py reuse-plan` unions a job's scopes to decide whether its last pass on a PR still holds, so a lane missing here makes its job always run, and a job whose real inputs a scope misses could be wrongly reused. scope = extended regex over changed paths; lane runs if ANY file matches (--all overrides). heavy=true needs --with-heavy. timeout_s hard cap; expiry -> status=timeout (exit 2). require_cmd: any missing -> skipped(missing-tool). command runs at repo root — keep byte-parity with the CI job's own repro line. Edit a workflow lane and this file in the SAME commit. INTENTIONALLY NOT MIRRORED (CI-only): build, build-images, coverage (combines the unit/integration/bridge slices; fail-under 80 on master, report-only on PRs), docker-image, regression-proof, validate-release-manifest, test-harness-tools, trivy-scan (advisory), changelog-sync (auto-fix PR job). Known deltas: py-tests mirrors via Dagger not byte-parity flake-gate slices; alert-rules needs locally installed pint/promtool (CI pins v0.87.0/v3.1.0 from release tarballs); whole-repo scopes are stricter than CI's changed-file scoping (safe direction). Post-merge note: master pinned bandit/xenon/interrogate and split ignore-ratchet into ignore-whys + ignore-staleness + tool-pins (2026-08 merge of origin/master).

lanes.name: deps
lanes.command: pnpm run quality:deps && pnpm run quality:pkg-json

lanes.name: api-schema
lanes.$comment: THE source of truth for what can change the generated API contract: the prek `api-types` hook's `files:` must match it byte for byte, and code-quality.yml's `changes` job greps it out of this file. A FastAPI/Pydantic bump changes the generated output with no route edit, so the manifests count as inputs. Enforced by scripts/ci/tests/test_api_schema_scope.py.

lanes.name: package-hygiene
lanes.command: pnpm run quality:publint && pnpm run quality:attw

lanes.name: python-ruff
lanes.command: uvx --no-build ruff@0.14.13 check . && uvx --no-build ruff@0.14.13 format --check .

lanes.name: python-mypy
lanes.command: uv run --project apps/api --frozen --group backend --group dev mypy apps/api/app apps/voice-agent/src libs/shared/py tools/lints --ignore-missing-imports

lanes.name: import-cost
lanes.$comment: Imports the real modules in fresh subprocesses, so it needs the synced venv; --report matches the CI step, which measures without gating until the base layers stop importing upward.

lanes.name: interrogate
lanes.command: uvx --no-build interrogate==1.7.0 -c pyproject.toml apps/api apps/voice-agent libs/shared/py

lanes.name: xenon
lanes.command: uvx --no-build xenon==0.9.3 --max-absolute F --max-modules E --max-average B apps/api apps/voice-agent libs/shared/py -e 'apps/api/tests/**' -e 'apps/api/scripts/**' -e 'libs/shared/py/tests/**'

lanes.name: bandit
lanes.command: FILES=$(scripts/ci/changes.sh py-source); if [ "$FILES" = "__FULL__" ]; then uvx --no-build bandit@1.9.4 -c pyproject.toml -r apps/api/app apps/voice-agent/src libs/shared/py --severity-level low --confidence-level low; elif [ -z "$FILES" ]; then echo "bandit: no changed Python source"; else uvx --no-build bandit@1.9.4 -c pyproject.toml $FILES --severity-level low --confidence-level low; fi

lanes.name: pip-audit
lanes.command: uv export --frozen --no-emit-workspace -o /tmp/gaia-verify-requirements.txt && uvx --no-build pip-audit==2.10.1 --strict --skip-editable --disable-pip --ignore-vuln GHSA-wj6h-64fc-37mp --ignore-vuln PYSEC-2026-1325 -r /tmp/gaia-verify-requirements.txt

lanes.name: alert-rules
lanes.command: uv run --no-build tools/alert-rules/extract_promql.py -o tools/alert-rules/gaia-rules.yaml --test-dir tools/alert-rules/tests && pint --no-color --offline --config config/pint.hcl lint tools/alert-rules/gaia-rules.yaml && promtool check rules tools/alert-rules/gaia-rules.yaml && promtool test rules tools/alert-rules/tests/*.yaml

lanes.name: semgrep
lanes.command: GITDIR=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir) && docker run --rm --volume "$PWD:/src" --volume "$GITDIR:$GITDIR" --workdir /src semgrep/semgrep@sha256:b68f9b68483955b85042dac7b4533757779625a02dcf91e470da4c2df1b430be semgrep scan --config tools/semgrep/p-python.yaml apps/api/app --error --metrics=off

lanes.name: test-mutation
lanes.command: uv sync --frozen --package gaia --group backend --group dev && bash scripts/ci/mutation.sh local
